name: Unify Group
summary: Unify Group SA engages in the thematic media business in France. The company offers various content, products, and services to audiences, as well as multi-media and multi-format brands. It also provides brand marketing, such as OTC or event-based advertising services; and performance marketing, including affiliation or programmatic advertising solutions. The company serves advertisers and general public through print, web, social media, TV, podcasts, and events. The company was formerly known as Reworld Media Société Anonyme and changed its name to Unify Group SA in June 2026. Unify Group SA was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.
